name: Map Fold Card
description: A folded paper map that pulls open sideways in accordion pleats, then unfolds downward into a sheet that keeps its creases.

props.name: title
props.description: Printed on the cover panel, the one you see while the map is folded.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A smaller line under the title, such as the scale.

props.name: children
props.description: The inside of the sheet: a map, a table, a picture. It fills the whole sheet and is drawn on every panel, so keep it free of controls. The sheet is pale paper in both themes: print on it with var(--miyuki-map-fold-card-ink), and use var(--miyuki-map-fold-card-paper) for halos behind labels.

props.name: rows
props.description: Panels down, from 1 to 3. The sheet is folded across these first, so they open last.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled state. Opening pulls the pleats apart, then lets the lower panels down; folding goes back the same way.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the map is opened or folded.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the open sheet in pixels. The height follows from the panels; it shrinks to fit a narrower container.

props.name: openLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the folded map, which is a button; the title is added to it.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Text of the small button that appears in the corner of the open map on hover or focus.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, a group; give it an aria-label.
